components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized to E.164 form:
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and is the value stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            supplied it is used to derive the owner's age band relative to the
            registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099), fall within
            that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used when creating an owner. When another owner already
            has the same last name and address (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) the create is normally rejected with 409; setting
            this flag to true acknowledges the shared household and allows the create.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is
                a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners at the time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same
                household. It is assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' set to true and another owner already has the
                same last name and address; both owners then share this value.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first and last names (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation: starting at 1, plus 1 when an email address is present,
                plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0),
                capped at 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration day at the time it was created, flagging a
                bulk-signup surge.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from the birth date and computed
                against the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                when 18 to 64 inclusive, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate
                detection into a single value formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, when created, softly matched an existing owner
                by sharing the same last name and postcode but with a different

## Summary

I implemented `telephoneDisplay` as a derived, read-only field on the owner, following the codebase's existing convention for computed fields (like `locality`, `contactPreference`, `ageBand`).

Two changes:

1. **`Owner.java`** — added `getTelephoneDisplay()`, which formats the stored E.164 `telephone` for humans: `'+'` + country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by single spaces (e.g. `+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`). It treats `+1` (NANP) as a one-digit country code and other codes as two digits, matching the country-code handling already used in the controller's `hasValidNationalLength`. It returns the raw value unchanged for anything not well-formed and `null` when telephone is unset. The raw `telephone` getter is untouched, so `telephone` stays E.164.

2. **`openapi.yml`** — added a `telephoneDisplay` read-only string property to the `Owner` schema. MapStruct auto-maps it from `Owner.getTelephoneDisplay()` into the generated `OwnerDto` by name, so it appears in the JSON response.

The new `Cp37Tests` passes (`telephone` = `+61412345678`, `telephoneDisplay` = `+61 412 345 678`), and all 51 existing/new tests are green.
